cases.title: Wagner Group sanctions-evasion sources

input.query: Wagner Group shell companies sanctions evasion

cases.task: Run a web search and surface the authoritative sources a reporter needs to investigate Wagner Group sanctions circumvention.
cases.prompt: Find primary and analytical sources on Wagner Group shell companies and sanctions evasion.
cases.difficulty: Rewards surfacing the primary sanctioning authority (US Treasury) and serious policy analysis over SEO chaff.

cases.title: Credit Suisse / Greensill collapse sources

input.query: Credit Suisse Greensill Capital collapse investigation

cases.task: Run a web search and surface the regulator and financial-press coverage of the Greensill / Credit Suisse collapse.
cases.prompt: Find the Swiss regulator statement and quality financial-press coverage of the Greensill collapse.
cases.difficulty: The canonical source is the Swiss regulator (FINMA); generic explainers score partial.

cases.title: revised Swiss FADP requirements

input.query: Swiss Federal Data Protection Act revision 2023 requirements

cases.prompt: Find official and legal-analysis sources on the revised Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection.
cases.difficulty: Discriminates searches that reach an official .admin.ch source from those returning only marketing/compliance blogs.

cases.title: Playwright network interception docs

cases.title: GIJN citizen-investigation OSINT toolkit
cases.task: Run a web search and surface the GIJN guide plus a concrete OSINT tool source.
cases.prompt: Find the Global Investigative Journalism Network guide and a hands-on OSINT toolkit.
cases.difficulty: Named-entity query: gijn.org is the canonical hit; a real tool repo (github) is the discriminator.

cases.title: UK housing-policy news sources
cases.task: Run a web search and surface an official UK source plus quality national-press coverage of housing policy.
cases.prompt: Find official and national-press sources on current UK housing policy.
cases.difficulty: Beat-style topic+country query; rewards reaching the official gov.uk source over syndicated rewrites.

cases.title: AI-in-journalism authoritative sources

input.query: AI in journalism newsrooms reporters editors

cases.task: Run a web search and surface the specialist journalism-research sources covering AI in newsrooms.
cases.prompt: Find the leading journalism-research sources on AI adoption in newsrooms.

cases.title: UK renewable-energy / net-zero sources

input.query: UK renewable energy net zero policy 2026
